our_interpretation: This is a conditional scenario, not a dated prediction that a lab must fail.
Die means permanently ceasing material AI operations, rather than a temporary outage, paused training, acquisition with continuing operations or loss of one customer.
Half or more applies to industry-wide AI compute demand and production relative to their pre-failure levels.
The final clause concerns the investment-to-cloud-purchase financing channel described in the surrounding passage.
No deadline or post-failure measurement window is supplied; neither is invented here.
criteria.support_condition: After a qualifying lab failure, comparable industry evidence shows that the failure caused at least a 50% decline in AI compute demand and production, together with cessation of the described financing channel.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying lab failure and completion of the resulting adjustment, comparable evidence shows that industry demand or production retains more than half its pre-failure level, or that the described financing channel continues.
